card.title: How To Fix iPhone X With No Service or Always Searching

source.title: How To Fix iPhone X With No Service or Always Searching

claims.statement: iPhone X baseband faults usually come from sandwich separation (check for ripped pads, test in iSocket, reball); a bottom board swap rules out the whole cellular circuit (move BB CPU, BB EEPROM and Wi-Fi).
A baseband CPU reball alone has a lower success rate; the fault may be BBPMU or elsewhere.
Test calls after reassembly: no call audio points at a bad sandwich reball.

procedure: Split sandwich; repair ripped pads; test in iSocket.
Consider bottom board swap or BB CPU reball.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
